scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c auto "npm run dev -w @loop/server" "npm run dev -w @loop/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @loop/client && npm run build -w @loop/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @loop/shared && npm run typecheck -w @loop/server && npm run typecheck -w @loop/client
scripts.heroku-cleanup: rm -rf apps/client/src apps/client/public apps/client/*.html apps/client/vite.config.ts apps/client/tsconfig.json apps/client/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/shared/src apps/server/src apps/server/tsconfig.json && find node_modules/uWebSockets.js -name 'uws_*.node' ! -name 'uws_linux_x64_*' -delete
